individualClassifications.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
individualClassifications.reason: This is a method-local null-key or null-value negative input, never shared with workers. ConcurrentHashMap rejects construction of the deliberately invalid map before the constructor under Test can inspect it.

individualClassifications.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
individualClassifications.reason: Standalone JUnit owns its two-worker pool through try-with-resources; exactly32 finite in-memory copy tasks create separate mutable maps and every future uses5SECONDS. No service/Root/native/background lifecycle ownership.
